identity: Maastricht University FASoS Arts and Culture BA, English, 2026–2027
curriculum: The adopted Maastricht FASoS EER Article 3.6.1 pages 15–18 supplies 180 EC: 96 elementary, 54 specialisation and 30 graduation. Year one includes 1 EC compulsory mentoring. Later mentoring is optional and zero credit. The chosen period-four pair is Othering Europe and Analysing Arts II; period five is Power and Democracy and Doing Conceptual Analysis II. Both pairs are in semester four. The arts analysis choice uses 3 EC and relates to the programme’s arts focus. For either 4 EC methods alternative, its extra credit counts toward the 30 EC semester-five elective space. Year three includes 30 EC approved open study in semester five, then Doing Research in Arts and Culture and the English research proposal at 7 EC each and the 16 EC English thesis. The English research and writing, proposal and thesis choices are consistent with Article 3.3.1.
progression: Article 4.2 requires positive binding study advice (45.5 first-year credits) before year two, all 60 first-year credits before year three, and all 60 first-year plus at least 45 second-year credits before the thesis. The proposal result is retained only if the thesis is passed in the same academic year. Article 3.8 permits approved minors, external courses, internships and other options subject to route-specific restrictions and academic approval. The example preserves open space and excludes noncompulsory mentoring, internships, honours and study abroad from compulsory credit claims.
